title: Nexus PC entitlement token payload v1
description: Decoded payload of an entitlement token: kid "." base64url(payload JSON) "." base64url(ES256 signature over the ASCII bytes of kid "." payload-segment), see docs/API.md «Токен прав». The kid lives only in the first segment, never in the payload. The payload is parsed only after the signature verified, by a strict parser: duplicate keys at any depth and non-integer number literals (fraction, exponent, -0) are rejected before this schema applies. Unknown fields are rejected. Time fields are Unix seconds. Relations between times (exp - iat <= 86400, 0 <= graceUntil - exp <= 604800, iat <= now + 300), iss and pcId are checked by the agent, not by this schema.

sub.description: Opaque account subject. Never forwarded to clients.
